user.title: Chauffage
user.description: Weekly heating schedules for your thermostats. After setup, open Chauffage in the sidebar to choose your thermostats.

import_package.title: Import from the package
import_package.description: The ha-chauffage package (v0.1) is installed. Its schedules ({thermostats} thermostats, {schedules} schedules), its current overrides and the active schedule will be imported, and its two automations turned off so that only one scheduler drives your thermostats. You will then be told how to remove the package.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
abort.package_too_new: The installed package saved its schedules in a newer format than this version of the integration understands. Update the integration first.

init.title: Chauffage options
init.description: Default settings. Presets and what they mean for each thermostat are set in the Chauffage panel (Presets tab).

data.access_level: Access level of users who are not administrators

data_description.override_duration: How long an override lasts, at most. A setpoint changed by hand becomes an override.
data_description.manual_override_end: When an override ends. A slot that starts in less than 15 min doesn't count.
data_description.off_override_end: When a thermostat that was turned off resumes its schedule: by hand, from the card, or by an automation that turns it off without an end.
data_description.use_presets: A preset uses the thermostat's own preset with the same name when it has one (Versatile Thermostat: comfort, eco, boost, frost). Turned off, every thermostat is driven by temperatures, set in the Chauffage panel (Presets tab).
data_description.show_in_sidebar: For administrators, and for every user with the access level Set up. Turned off, you still open the Chauffage panel from the cards and from a scheduled thermostat's device (Visit).
data_description.access_level: What users who are not administrators may change. Administrators can always change everything. With Set up, their changes reach every room.

package_installed.title: Remove the ha-chauffage package
package_installed.description: The Chauffage integration now schedules your thermostats; the package's automations have been turned off. To finish: delete `packages/chauffage/` and `www/chauffage/` from your configuration folder, remove the `/local/chauffage/chauffage-loader.js` line from `frontend: extra_module_url` and the three `sensor.*_chauffage` lines from `recorder: exclude` in `configuration.yaml`, then restart Home Assistant. In your own automations, replace `input_select.mode_chauffage` with `{schedule_entity}`.

init.title: {entity_id} is gone
init.description: Chauffage schedules {entity_id}, but this entity no longer exists in Home Assistant. If it was renamed or replaced, schedule the new thermostat in the Chauffage panel (Thermostats tab).

menu_options.keep: Keep it (the entity will come back)

options.plan: Plan: also the weeks and the schedules, from the cards
options.set_up: Set up: also the Chauffage panel (presets, rules, thermostats)

options.next_slot_within_duration: For the override duration, or less if a slot starts first

set_override.name: Set an override
set_override.description: Sets a scheduled thermostat's temperature or preset, and turns it off or on, for a while, then it resumes its schedule.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A Chauffage preset, set to what it means on this thermostat (or one of the thermostat's own presets); or give a temperature.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: Off to turn the thermostat off, or an HVAC mode to turn it on in. Without it, the thermostat is on. Off alone, without a duration or an end, lasts as the setting Turned off says. Off and fan only take no temperature and no preset.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long, in minutes (default: the integration's option).

end.name: End
end.description: When the override ends (instead of a duration).

clear_override.name: End an override
clear_override.description: Ends a thermostat's override now: it resumes its schedule.

activate_schedule.name: Activate a schedule
activate_schedule.description: Activates a schedule by its id, which does not change when the schedule is renamed.

schedule.name: Schedule id
schedule.description: The schedule's id, shown in the card (schedule menu, Rename).

get_schedules.name: Get schedules
get_schedules.description: Gives the schedules (id, name, switch), the active one, and the one the activation rules give, for scripts.

get_week.name: Get week
get_week.description: Gives each thermostat's week in a schedule (the active one by default): each day's slots, with their start, end and preset, for scripts.

schedule.name: Schedule id
schedule.description: The schedule's id (default: the active schedule).
